page.content:
The Arcade Cashier is a chain-smoking man who gives out cash at the Noiseland Video Arcade. Homer gets some cash off of him and pretends he needs it for laundry. The cash guy doesn't believe him and mocks him.

page.overview:
Who is Arcade Cashier?

The Arcade Cashier is a chain-smoking man who gives out cash at the Noiseland Video Arcade. Homer gets some cash off of him and pretends he needs it for laundry. The cash guy doesn't believe him and mocks him.
